Reading the past seasons…

24-hour IMD auctions. Minimum raise: 5%, rounded up. Late bids extend the deadline by 10 minutes. Outbid refunds can be withdrawn immediately. Without bids, the top painter receives the NFT and the pot rolls forward; a blank canvas stays in escrow.

Small pixels. Shared upside.

01 / BuyGet i/p through PlaceRouter. Each buy gives you paint that never expires.

02 / PaintMake a corner your own. Current pixel owners share 67% of the base 2% hook fee.

03 / CollectClaim trading earnings anytime. Final pixel owners share their season’s winning bid and pot.
